environment.description: Same container image deployed as an AWS Lambda function (custom runtime, web adapter) exposed exclusively via Lambda Function URL. The Function URL auth-type is set to AWS_IAM (not NONE). The Lambda resource-based policy contains no principal wildcard grants — only a specific IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalApiCallerRole) has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The function URL's CORS configuration has AllowOrigins set to empty array (no origins allowed). There is no CloudFront distribution, no API Gateway, and no ALB in front — the only ingress path is the Function URL itself. Unauthenticated HTTP requests receive a 403 Forbidden response from the Lambda Function URL service before the function code executes.
